question:
I'm putting together a simple dashboard page for a small internal tool and need help with both the UI references and the architecture drawing.  
    Could you find a clean icon that represents a "statistics overview", show me the documentation and a couple of examples for the Ant Design Card component, and then generate a small architecture diagram that shows:  
    - a frontend module using that Card component,  
    - a backend API service,  
    - and a data storage layer?  
    Keep the diagram high-level.
answer:
All three pieces are ready. --- ## 1. Icon: `analytics-01` — clean statistics overview **Recommended style:** `stroke-rounded` (clean, minimal, plays well with Ant Design's line-icon aesthetic) | Field | Value | |---|---| | Icon name | `analytics-01` | | Category | business | | Tags | report, overview, dashboard, bar, graph, chart | | React export | `Analytics01Icon` | | Glyph (unicode) | `󱖽` (decimal `988605`) | | Secondary layer glyph | `󰃝` (for duotone/bulk, `analytics-01-secondary`) | ```tsx import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react'; import { Analytics01Icon } from '@hugeicons-pro/core-stroke-rounded'; ``` Install: `npm install @hugeicons/react` + the style package (`@hugeicons/core-free-icons`, or `@hugeicons-pro/core-stroke-rounded` for pro). **Why this one:** it renders as a simple bar-chart-in-a-frame — instantly readable at 16–20px in a Card header or stat tile, unlike the pie-chart variants (busier) or `infographic` (too detailed at small sizes). Good alternates if you want a trend line instead: `chart-02` (`󱤋`) or `analytics-03` (`󱖿`). --- ## 2. Ant Design `Card` — docs summary The base container for text, lists, images, and paragraphs; explicitly intended for **backend overview / dashboard pages**. ```jsx Card content ``` **Key props** | Prop | Description | Type | Default | |---|---|---|---| | `title` | Card title | ReactNode | – | | `extra` | Action area in top-right | ReactNode | – | | `actions` | Action group at bottom | `Array` | – | | `cover` | Card cover | ReactNode | – | | `hoverable` | Lifts on hover | boolean | `false` | | `loading` | Skeleton placeholder | boolean | `false` | | `size` | Card size | `default` \| `small` | `default` | | `variant` | Visual variant | `outlined` \| `borderless` | `outlined` | | `tabList` / `activeTabKey` / `onTabChange` | Tabs inside card | – | – | | `classNames` / `styles` | Per-slot styling (object or function) | – | – | ⚠️ **Version notes:** `variant` was added in **5.24.0** and replaces `bordered` (now deprecated). `classNames`/`styles` with SemanticDOM slots are also recent — check your antd version if you plan to use them. Sub-components: `Card.Grid` (grid cells, `hoverable` defaults `true`), `Card.Meta` (`avatar` / `title` / `description`). --- ## 3. Two Card examples ### A. Grid cards — the classic overview layout This is the pattern to copy for a statistics dashboard: a responsive `Row`/`Col` of borderless cards. ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Col, Row } from 'antd'; const App: React.FC = () => ( Card content Card content Card content ); export default App; ``` ### B. Standard card — title, extra action, content ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Space } from 'antd'; const App: React.FC = () => ( More} style={{ width: 300 }}>

Architecture diagram ![PlantUML Diagram](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/svg/JP0nRy9038Lt_mehKnaYzWuLf051HLlKf1kBIKnoudAN-YuWLFM_rw5IORFydfy_UnOYIHmw2z54oxXsaSMHnPn2k_SaDQQuCasRRlZ45kTIjIPo5GTXW70qhYUX3YlVzTwnYqMyQ8oeWrnZ-SuIMghzsRW63sI3JlTK7QbXJFwNbjxR1By1RtcOBCMhxcfyzVLWUUSURcoVwydE3O43pjMQSp2DmsTL4gI0omNy0Dn5PRfnJ9flrrYmd4mrndqiYXAd-5AylqskSof3JP7s59GkrmgBw6LatT25PKJ8_gnv1h1SO9e-NKCVSLMMsqBl_neun01ZSnJpJ3NjYL7MAPv5dnW0PagZp_y5) Three boxes, top to bottom: **Frontend Module (Dashboard UI)** → **Backend API Service (REST/JSON)** → **Data Storage Layer (DB)**. Deliberately no internal detail — no auth, no cache, no queues — so it stays a true context diagram. Source: ```plantuml @startuml title Internal Dashboard - High-Level Architecture skinparam componentStyle rectangle skinparam shadowing false package "Internal Tool" { component "Frontend Module\n(Dashboard UI)\nuses Ant Design Card" as FE } component "Backend API Service\n(REST / JSON)" as API database "Data Storage Layer\n(DB)" as DB FE --> API : HTTPS requests API --> DB : queries / writes @enduml ``` --- ### Suggested next step Put them together: a `` of three `` tiles, each with `` next to the title and one headline number in the body — that gives you a functional stats overview in about 30 lines. Want me to write out that full dashboard component?

Card 组件的文档：
## 何时使用
最基础的卡片容器，可承载文字、列表、图片、段落，常用于后台概览页面。
## API
```jsx
<Card title="卡片标题">卡片内容</Card>
```
| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | 卡片操作组，位置在卡片底部 | Array<ReactNode> | - |  |
| activeTabKey | 当前激活页签的 key | string | - |  |
| ~~bordered~~ | 是否有边框, 请使用 `variant` 替换 | boolean | true |  |
| variant | 形态变体 | `outlined` \| `borderless` \| | `outlined` | 5.24.0 |
| classNames | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> | - |  |
| cover | 卡片封面 | ReactNode | - |  |
| defaultActiveTabKey | 初始化选中页签的 key，如果没有设置 activeTabKey | string | `第一个页签的 key` |  |
| extra | 卡片右上角的操作区域 | ReactNode | - |  |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起 | boolean | false |  |
| loading | 当卡片内容还在加载中时，可以用 loading 展示一个占位 | boolean | false |  |
| size | card 的尺寸 | `default` \| `small` | `default` |  |
| tabBarExtraContent | tab bar 上额外的元素 | ReactNode | - |  |
| tabList | 页签标题列表 | [TabItemType](/components/tabs-cn#tabitemtype)[] | - |  |
| tabProps | [Tabs](/components/tabs-cn#tabs) | - | - |  |
| title | 卡片标题 | ReactNode | - |  |
| type | 卡片类型，可设置为 `inner` 或 不设置 | string | - |  |
| styles | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> | - |  |
| onTabChange | 页签切换的回调 | (key) => void | - |  |
### Card.Grid
| 参数      | 说明                   | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| className | 网格容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起       | boolean       | true   |      |
| style     | 定义网格容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
### Card.Meta
| 参数        | 说明               | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| avatar      | 头像/图标          | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| className   | 容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| description | 描述内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| style       | 定义容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
| title       | 标题内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |

如有版本说明需要提醒用户需要使用某个版本及以上的版本
